metadata.description: AI-powered secure, autonomous development workflow. RePPITS methodology with configurable compliance gates — enable any of HIPAA, HITRUST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 (healthcare is one aspect).

plugins.name: reppit-health
plugins.description: Run /reppit for the full Research → Propose → Plan → Implement → Test → Secure workflow with healthcare compliance gates, or invoke any phase as a standalone slash command. /reppit-loop runs a continuous goal-loop over an optimizable RICE-scored backlog. /signals is a shared team hub where any loop emits observations and any loop consumes them, with a dynamic dashboard. Adaptive risk-tiered gates, a bounded autonomous fix loop, resumable Tasks (/resume-reppit), parallel sub-issues, and opt-in headroom token compression. /secure runs your enabled compliance frameworks (any of HIPAA, HITRUST, ISO 27001, SOC 2) against your diff and separates code-verifiable findings from organizational controls.
